supplemental_items.interpretation: Dirty boundary inclusive [0,len(main)]. Entry reuse requires same ordinal, exact tuple (First, Break, intrabar, str top, top source index, str bottom, bottom source index) and Break<dirty. Recompute span and path even without owners, changed only when new entry !=old; removed tails eliminated by pair bounds. No general input mutation validation.
